methodology: Ranked by Michelin restaurant density within 1 hour by public transit (RTC Deuce bus / Las Vegas Monorail) or walk from the hotel. Las Vegas has NO subway/underground metro, so 'subway or bus' is fulfilled by the Deuce bus + Monorail (the city's rail-on-stilts). From any central-Strip hotel all 24 Michelin-distinguished restaurants are reachable within 60 min; the differentiator is walk-time to the 4 starred restaurants and total hotel cost.
irregularity: Las Vegas has no subway/underground metro system as of 2026 (confirmed by multiple transit sources). The 1-hour 'subway or bus' criterion is therefore evaluated using the RTC Deuce bus (24h Strip bus) and the Las Vegas Monorail.
